lead.title: @huggingface/kernels ships 207 WebGPU kernels for faster local browser inference
lead.summary: Hugging Face released a JavaScript library and 207 Apache-2.0 WebGPU kernels for running optimized in-browser inference, plus Fleet, a crowdsourced GPU benchmarking tool. On an Apple M4 GPU the kernels benchmark 2.57x faster than ONNX Runtime Web across 809 test cases, a real step toward fully local, no-install AI.

top_stories.title: Perplexity brings Hybrid Compute to Mac, keeping sensitive AI work on-device
top_stories.summary: Splits tasks between frontier cloud models and local LLMs (Gemma 4 E4B, Qwen3.6 35B-A3B) on Apple Silicon, with an on-disk PII classifier keeping confidential data on-device. Requires macOS 15 and 24GB+ unified memory; local tokens are free.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek opens weights for V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, its first V4 vision model
top_stories.summary: An MIT-licensed 305B sparse MoE that can process images, shipped entirely in FP8 (~284GB before the ~42GB vision tower). Community 4-bit GGUF quants from ~155GB are already up on Hugging Face, making it self-hostable on multi-GPU rigs.

top_stories.title: Home Assistant 2026.9 adds active alerts, a Matter map, and local voice speech-to-text improvements
top_stories.summary: The monthly release brings active alerts and favorites to the Security dashboard, a Matter network map view, a shared Sources pane, and better speech-to-text from Nabu Casa for local voice assistants.

top_stories.title: DeepX links its DX-M1 NPU to AWS IoT Greengrass for remote edge-AI deployment
top_stories.summary: Ties the on-device DX-M1 NPU to AWS IoT Core and Greengrass so factories, robots, and industrial vision devices receive model and software updates remotely without on-site visits. A DX-M2 generative-AI chip is planned next.

items.title: The structure of quantization damage: why the next bit should be spent globally
items.summary: Causal mixed-precision intervention across 9 open-weight models in 4 architecture families finds 8-bit is near-lossless and that global granularity beats selectively protecting critical layers.

items.title: SinkPruner: sink-free visual token pruning for multimodal LLMs
items.summary: A sink-free visual token pruning method cuts computational overhead on long visual token sequences, lowering multimodal LLM inference cost for local hardware.

items.title: LatentPress compresses context beyond text and vision
items.summary: Writes conversational histories and long documents into continuous latent memory tokens a frozen model consumes directly, aiming at long-context inference efficiency.

items.title: Knowledge distillation during mid-training favors reasoning over factual recall
items.summary: Distilling at the mid-training stage disproportionately improves reasoning over factual recall, relevant for practitioners distilling into smaller local models.

items.title: Behaviorally effective LoRA writes are sparse and structured
items.summary: Fine-tuning studies find behaviorally effective LoRA updates are sparse and structured, informing parameter-efficient tuning for consumer hardware.

items.title: Openheim: Rust LLM agent runtime with ACP, MCP and multi-provider support
items.summary: A provider-agnostic agent runtime (TUI, CLI, ACP stdio, WebSocket/REST) supporting local backends like Ollama, vLLM and LM Studio, with auto-discovered MCP servers.

items.title: mcptunnels: ngrok for MCP with OAuth 2.1
items.summary: Spawns any stdio MCP server, bridges it to Streamable HTTP, and prints an anonymous 24-hour public URL gated behind OAuth 2.1, letting remote clients reach a laptop-local MCP server without deployment.

items.title: vpipe: real-time multimodal AI pipelines on Apple Silicon
items.summary: A concurrent pipeline framework for real-time LLM/VLM/ASR and video generation with a from-scratch on-device inference stack on a custom Metal backend.

items.title: OpenAI bought tens of thousands of Mac minis and Studios for AI-agent training
items.summary: Reporting ties OpenAI's purchase of screenless Mac minis and Studios (with Anthropic renting similar capacity) to RL and computer-use agent training, driven by Apple's unified memory.

items.title: LocalLM Lab 1.0.0-beta: one API across Apple on-device, Claude, and local MLX models
items.summary: A model-calling layer routing tasks across Apple's FoundationModels, Claude, and local MLX open-weight models on macOS 27 with preflight validation and residency management.
